# =========================================================
#  Utils: accumulate "filtered-out" samples into one RDS
# =========================================================

init_filtered_out <- function(file = "filtered_out.rds") {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    saveRDS(NULL, file)
  }
}

append_filtered_out <- function(ps_removed, file = "filtered_out.rds") {
  # ps_removed: phyloseq object containing ONLY samples you want to store
  if (is.null(ps_removed) || nsamples(ps_removed) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  old <- if (file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else NULL

  if (is.null(old)) {
    new <- ps_removed
  } else {
    # Merge (keep all taxa encountered in removed samples)
    new <- merge_phyloseq(old, ps_removed)

    # Ensure unique sample names (extra-safe)
    sn <- sample_names(new)
    if (any(duplicated(sn))) {
      sample_names(new) <- make.unique(sn)
    }
  }

  saveRDS(new, file)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Helper: given ps_before and ps_after, get removed samples phyloseq
get_removed_samples <- function(ps_before, ps_after) {
  removed_names <- setdiff(sample_names(ps_before), sample_names(ps_after))
  if (length(removed_names) == 0) return(NULL)
  prune_samples(removed_names, ps_before)
}

##################################################################################################################
########################################### Controls #############################################################
##################################################################################################################

process_controls <- function(comm_file, meta_file, tax_file, prefix, D6310_expected_species) {
  library(tidyverse)
  library(phyloseq)

  message("🔍 Traitement des données : ", prefix)

  # 1. upload file
  comm <- read.table(comm_file, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
  metadata <- read.csv(meta_file, sep = ";", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
  taxmat <- as.matrix(read.csv(tax_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1))
  
  # name harmonization
  colnames(comm) <- dplyr::recode(
    colnames(comm),
    "DNA_RNA_Shield" = "DNA.RNA.Shield",
    "negative"       = "X."
  )

  # 2. select controls
  control_samples <- c("X.", "D6310", "DNA.RNA.Shield")
  metadata_control <- metadata %>% filter(Sample_ID %in% control_samples)

  if (nrow(metadata_control) == 0) {
    message("⚠️ Aucun contrôle trouvé pour ", prefix)
    return(data.frame())
  }

  OTU  <- otu_table(comm, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  TAX  <- tax_table(taxmat)
  SAMP <- sample_data(metadata_control)

  # Phyloseq at OTU level, no tax_glom
  physeq_ini <- merge_phyloseq(OTU, TAX, SAMP)

  # Prepare complete tax_table
  tax_df_full <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_ini)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("OTU")

  # 3. expected family in D6310 (from expected species)
  expected_families <- tax_df_full %>%
    filter(Species %in% D6310_expected_species) %>%
    distinct(Family) %>%
    pull(Family)

  message("   ✅ Familles attendues pour D6310 : ",
          paste(unique(expected_families), collapse = ", "))

  # 4. Extraction function at OTU level
  extract_problematic <- function(physeq_obj, sample_name,
                                  expected_species = NULL,
                                  expected_families = NULL) {
    if (!(sample_name %in% sample_names(physeq_obj))) return(data.frame())

    otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_obj))
    tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_obj)) %>%
      rownames_to_column("OTU")

    # keep only controls column + OTUs with >= 10 reads
    df <- otu_df %>%
      select(all_of(sample_name)) %>%
      filter(.data[[sample_name]] >= 10) %>%
      rownames_to_column("OTU") %>%
      left_join(tax_df, by = "OTU")

    # filter out expected
    if (!is.null(expected_families)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(!(Family %in% expected_families))
    } else if (!is.null(expected_species)) {
      df <- df %>% filter(!(Species %in% expected_species))
    }

    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(data.frame())

    df %>%
      transmute(
        OTU,
        Species,
        Reads_number = .data[[sample_name]],
        Control = sample_name
      )
  }

  # 5. Extraction for each control
  problem_D6310  <- extract_problematic(physeq_ini, "D6310",
                                        expected_families = expected_families)
  problem_Water  <- extract_problematic(physeq_ini, "X.")
  problem_Shield <- extract_problematic(physeq_ini, "DNA.RNA.Shield")

  # 6. Merge control table
  all_problems <- bind_rows(problem_D6310, problem_Water, problem_Shield)

  if (nrow(all_problems) == 0) {
    message("✅ Aucun OTU problématique final détecté dans ", prefix)
    return(data.frame())
  }

  # 7. For each OTU, keep the control where it is the most abundant
  result <- all_problems %>%
    group_by(OTU, Species) %>%   # unique OTU, Keep Species as info
    slice_max(order_by = Reads_number, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(OTU, Species, Reads_number)

  # 8. Export CSV
  write.csv(result, paste0("Problematic_OTUs_", prefix, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("📁 Résultat enregistré : Problematic_OTUs_", prefix, ".csv")

  return(result)
}

################################################################################################################
######################################### Preliminary Phyloseq #################################################
################################################################################################################

process_dataset <- function(prefix, otu_file, meta_file, tax_file, contaminated_file) {
  message("🔧 Traitement : ", prefix)

  # ----- 1. Importation -----
  comm <- read.table(otu_file, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
  metadata <- read.csv(meta_file, sep = ";", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
  metadata$HostSpecies <- dplyr::recode(
    metadata$HostSpecies,
    "D. willistoni" = "Willistoni sp."
  )
  taxmat <- as.matrix(read.csv(tax_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1))
  
  # control names Harmonization
  colnames(comm) <- dplyr::recode(
    colnames(comm),
    "DNA_RNA_Shield" = "DNA.RNA.Shield",
    "negative"       = "X."
  )

  # ----- 2. Delete controls -----
  control_names <- c("X.", "D6310", "DNA.RNA.Shield")
  metadata <- metadata[!(rownames(metadata) %in% control_names), ]
  comm <- comm[, !(colnames(comm) %in% control_names)]

  # ----- 3. clean column -----
  colnames(comm) <- gsub("([a-z])([0-9])", "\\1_\\2", colnames(comm))
  colnames(comm) <- tolower(colnames(comm))

  # ----- 4. delete contaminated pools -----
  contaminated_pools <- read_excel(contaminated_file)
  View(contaminated_pools)
  contaminated_pool <- unique(contaminated_pools$Pool)
  metadata <- metadata[!(rownames(metadata) %in% contaminated_pool), ]
  comm <- comm[, !(colnames(comm) %in% contaminated_pool)]

  # Synchronization
  metadata <- metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% colnames(comm), ]
  comm <- comm[, colnames(comm) %in% rownames(metadata)]

  # ----- 5. Effective table -----
  effectif_locality <- metadata %>%
    group_by(Locality, HostSpecies) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  effectif_global <- metadata %>%
    group_by(HostSpecies) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Locality = "All Locality")

  effectif_table <- bind_rows(effectif_locality, effectif_global)
  write.csv(effectif_table, paste0("Effectif_table_", prefix, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # ----- 6. Graphic -----
  g <- ggplot(effectif_table, aes(x = HostSpecies, y = count)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Locality) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 25),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 25),
          title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = "Number of samples", title = "Number of pools by species and locality") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), color = "white", hjust = 1.1, size = 5, vjust = 0.5) +
    coord_flip()

  ggsave(filename = paste0("Number_of_pools_", prefix, ".pdf"), plot = g, width = 18, height = 11)

  # ----- 7. create phyloseq object -----
  OTU <- otu_table(comm, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  TAX <- tax_table(taxmat)
  SAMP <- sample_data(metadata)
  physeq_ini <- merge_phyloseq(OTU, SAMP, TAX)

  # ----- 8. count "unknown species" -----
  physeq_tax_table <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_ini))
  num_unknown_species <- sum(physeq_tax_table$Species == "Unknown")
  message("🔍 ", num_unknown_species, " OTUs annotés comme 'unknown_species'")

  # ----- 9. species merging -----
  #physeq_ini_rs <- tax_glom(physeq_ini, taxrank = "Species")

  # ----- 10. Save -----
  #saveRDS(physeq_ini_rs, paste0("DROSO", prefix, "_Rs_physeq.Rs"))
  #write.csv(as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_ini_rs)), paste0("Taxonomy_concat_", prefix, ".csv"))

  #return(physeq_ini_rs)
  
  # ----- 10. Sauve without species merged -----
  saveRDS(physeq_ini, paste0("DROSO", prefix, "_Rs_physeq.Rs"))
  write.csv(as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_ini)), paste0("Taxonomy_concat_", prefix, ".csv"))

  return(physeq_ini)
}

################################################################################################################
######################################### Cleaned Phyloseq #####################################################
################################################################################################################

process_phyloseq_original <- function(prefix, physeq_file, problematic_file, is_fungal = FALSE, depth_threshold = 1000,
                                     filtered_out_file = paste0("filtered_out_", prefix, ".rds")) {

  message("🚀 Pipeline (original) : ", prefix)

  # Init the per-dataset accumulating RDS (once per call)
  init_filtered_out(filtered_out_file)

  # 1. upload phyloseq
  physeq.ini.Rs <- readRDS(physeq_file)
  Problematic_otu <- read.csv(problematic_file)

  # --- clean "Incertae Sedis sp. X" in tax_table --- #
  tax_ini <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq.ini.Rs))

  if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_ini)) {

    # Order tax_table column
    rank_cols <- intersect(
      c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
      colnames(tax_ini)
    )

    # Line where species format is "Incertae Sedis sp. X"
    inc_rows <- which(grepl("^Incertae\\s+Sedis\\s+sp\\.", tax_ini$Species, ignore.case = TRUE))

    if (length(inc_rows) > 0) {
      message("   ⚠️ Found ", length(inc_rows),
              " 'Incertae Sedis sp. X' entries in Species. Relabelling (no numbering)...")

      for (i in inc_rows) {
        ranks_vals <- tax_ini[i, rank_cols, drop = FALSE]

        # last clean taxonomic rank:
        ok_idx <- which(
          !is.na(ranks_vals[1, ]) &
            ranks_vals[1, ] != "" &
            !grepl("incertae\\s+sedis", ranks_vals[1, ], ignore.case = TRUE) &
            names(ranks_vals) != "Species"
        )

        if (!length(ok_idx)) {
          # if nothing is clean before Species → "Unknown Species"
          tax_ini$Species[i] <- "Unknown Species"
          next
        }

        last_ok_pos <- max(ok_idx)
        base_name   <- as.character(ranks_vals[1, last_ok_pos])

        # build "X sp." for each taxonomic rank under the last clean one
        lower_cols <- rank_cols[(last_ok_pos + 1):length(rank_cols)]
        lower_cols <- lower_cols[!is.na(lower_cols)]  # security

        if (length(lower_cols) > 0) {
          for (col in lower_cols) {
            tax_ini[i, col] <- paste0(base_name, " sp.")
          }
        }
      }

      # adding cleaned tax_table too phyloseq
      tax_table(physeq.ini.Rs) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_ini))
    }
  }

  # little check on Unknown
  tax_ini <- as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq.ini.Rs))
  if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_ini)) {
    message("   🔍 Unknown Species initiaux : ",
            sum(grepl("unknown", tax_ini$Species, ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  # 2. Subset Category
  subset_category <- subset_samples(physeq.ini.Rs, Category %in% c("Native", "Invasive"))
  message("🧃 Après subset Category (Native/Invasive): ", nsamples(subset_category),
          " samples, ", ntaxa(subset_category), " taxa")

  # 3. filtering on Prevalence
  prev0 <- apply(otu_table(subset_category),
                 MARGIN = ifelse(taxa_are_rows(subset_category), 1, 2),
                 FUN = function(x) sum(x > 0))
  ps1 <- prune_taxa(prev0 >= 1, subset_category)
  message("🍂 Après prune_taxa (prevalence >=1): ", nsamples(ps1),
          " samples, ", ntaxa(ps1), " taxa")

  # 3b. Prune phyla badly represented
  taxdf <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps1))
  phylum_counts <- table(taxdf$Phylum)
  message("   📊 Nombre de taxa par phylum :")
  print(phylum_counts)

  keepPhyla <- names(phylum_counts[phylum_counts >= 2])
  message("   ✅ Phyla gardés (>=2 taxa): ", paste(keepPhyla, collapse = ", "))

  taxa_to_keep <- rownames(taxdf)[taxdf$Phylum %in% keepPhyla]
  ps2 <- prune_taxa(taxa_to_keep, ps1)
  message("🧬 Après prune des phylums peu représentés: ", nsamples(ps2),
          " samples, ", ntaxa(ps2), " taxa")

  # 4. Delete spikes / Cyanobacteria / Fungi parasites
  if (is_fungal) {
    taxmat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps2))
    spikes_OTU <- rownames(taxmat)[ !(taxmat$Kingdom %in% c("Fungi", "Unknown Kingdom")) ]
    message("   🌋 Branch FUNGAL : spikes_OTU = ", length(spikes_OTU))
  } else {
    spikes_OTU <- c("FJ347755.1.1431","AJJU01000016.421.1936","CP002049.86621.88117","LN563868.1.1345",
                    "JN032373.1.1387","JN032376.1.1402","LWDA01001123.84979.86326",
                    "GEEO01017285.65.1522", "GEEO01017289.65.1399")
    message("   🌋 Branch BACTERIAL : spikes standards = ", length(spikes_OTU))
  }

  #------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------#
  otu_mat <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps2))
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps2)) {
    otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  }

  spikes_present <- intersect(rownames(otu_mat), spikes_OTU)
  message("   🔥 Spikes présents dans ps2 : ", length(spikes_present))

  spikes_reads <- colSums(otu_mat[spikes_present, , drop = FALSE])
  total_reads <- colSums(otu_mat)

  contamination_table <- data.frame(
    Sample = names(total_reads),
    Spike_Reads = spikes_reads[names(total_reads)],
    Total_Reads = total_reads,
    Percent_Contamination = round(100 * spikes_reads[names(total_reads)] / total_reads, 2)
  )

  contamination_table$Spike_Reads[is.na(contamination_table$Spike_Reads)] <- 0
  contamination_table$Percent_Contamination[is.na(contamination_table$Percent_Contamination)] <- 0

  # Delete spikes
  Taxa2keep <- setdiff(taxa_names(ps2), spikes_OTU)
  ps2k <- prune_taxa(Taxa2keep, ps2)
  message("🚫 Après suppression spikes: ", nsamples(ps2k),
          " samples, ", ntaxa(ps2k), " taxa")

  # 5. Delete sample with low read depth
  subset_samples <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps2k) >= depth_threshold, ps2k)

  # --- store removed (low-depth) samples ---
  removed_ps <- get_removed_samples(ps2k, subset_samples)
  append_filtered_out(removed_ps, filtered_out_file)

  message("⚖️ Après filtre profondeur >= ", depth_threshold, ": ",
          nsamples(subset_samples), " samples, ", ntaxa(subset_samples), " taxa")

  # 6. correct contamination
  otu_table_extracted <- as.data.frame(otu_table(subset_samples))

  # check if OTUs are well in line
  if (!taxa_are_rows(subset_samples)) {
    otu_table_extracted <- t(otu_table_extracted)
  }

  # Vminimal check : does Problematic_otu contain "OTU" column
  if (!"OTU" %in% colnames(Problematic_otu)) {
    stop("❌ La table 'Problematic_otu' doit contenir une colonne 'OTU'.")
  }
  if (!"Reads_number" %in% colnames(Problematic_otu)) {
    stop("❌ La table 'Problematic_otu' doit contenir une colonne 'Reads_number'.")
  }

  # correction OTU by OTU
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(Problematic_otu))) {
    otu_id <- Problematic_otu$OTU[i]
    value_to_subtract <- Problematic_otu$Reads_number[i]

    if (otu_id %in% rownames(otu_table_extracted)) {
      otu_table_extracted[otu_id, ] <- pmax(
        otu_table_extracted[otu_id, ] - value_to_subtract,
        0
      )
    }
  }

  # Add cleaned otu_table to phyloseq
  otu_table(subset_samples) <- otu_table(otu_table_extracted, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  message("🧹 Après correction contamination (même n): ",
          nsamples(subset_samples), " samples, ", ntaxa(subset_samples), " taxa")

  # 6b. clean tax_table
  taxmat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(subset_samples))

  if ("Species" %in% colnames(taxmat)) {

    # 6b-1) little cleaning
    taxmat$Species <- gsub("^uncultured\\s+", "", taxmat$Species)            # delete "uncultured " au début
    taxmat$Species <- gsub("\\s+BRTC-3$", "", taxmat$Species)                # delete suffixe " BRTC-3"
    taxmat$Species <- gsub("\\s+ATCC\\s+33386$", "", taxmat$Species)         # delete suffixe " ATCC 33386"
    taxmat$Species <- trimws(taxmat$Species)

    # 6b-3) gave unique identifiers to "Unknown Species"
    idx_unknown <- which(!is.na(taxmat$Species) & taxmat$Species == "Unknown Species")
    if (length(idx_unknown) > 0) {
      taxmat$Species[idx_unknown] <- paste0("Unknown Species_", seq_along(idx_unknown))
    }

    # add cleaned tax_table to phyloseq
    tax_table(subset_samples) <- tax_table(as.matrix(taxmat))

    message("🏷️ tax_table nettoyée: Unknown Species renommés = ", length(idx_unknown))
  }

  # 7. Work on proportion
  hilu <- filter_taxa(subset_samples, function(x) sum(x >= 2) >= 2, TRUE)
  message("   📉 Après filter_taxa(sum(x >= 2) >= 2): ",
          nsamples(hilu), " samples, ", ntaxa(hilu), " taxa")

  hilu.f <- prune_samples(sample_sums(hilu) >= 2, hilu)

  # --- store removed (too few reads after filtering taxa) samples ---
  removed_ps2 <- get_removed_samples(hilu, hilu.f)
  append_filtered_out(removed_ps2, filtered_out_file)

  message("🧮 Après prune_samples(sample_sums(hilu) >= 2): ",
          nsamples(hilu.f), " samples, ", ntaxa(hilu.f), " taxa")

  # Verify number of Unknown Species at the end
  tax_final <- as.data.frame(tax_table(hilu.f))
  if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_final)) {
    message("   🔍 Unknown Species finaux : ",
            sum(grepl("unknown", tax_final$Species, ignore.case = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  # 8. Save
  saveRDS(hilu.f, paste0("Clean_phyloseq_", prefix, ".rds"))

  # 9. Resume
  otu_table_temp <- data.frame(otu_table(hilu.f))
  column_sums <- colSums(otu_table_temp)
  message("🔍 MIN: ", min(column_sums),
          " | MAX: ", max(column_sums),
          " | TOTAL: ", sum(column_sums))

  # 10. effective
  metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu.f))
  effectif_locality <- metadata %>%
    group_by(Locality, HostSpecies) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  effectif_global <- metadata %>%
    group_by(HostSpecies) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Locality = "All Locality")

  effectif_table <- bind_rows(effectif_locality, effectif_global)
  write.csv(effectif_table, paste0("Effectif_table_filtered_", prefix, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  g <- ggplot(effectif_table, aes(x = HostSpecies, y = count)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Locality) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 25),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 25),
          title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Species", y = "Number of samples", title = "Number of pools by species and locality") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), color = "white", hjust = 1.1, size = 5, vjust = 0.5) +
    coord_flip()

  ggsave(filename = paste0("Number_of_pools_filtered_", prefix, ".pdf"),
         plot = g, width = 18, height = 11)

  return(hilu.f)
}

####################################################################################
############################### Add tree ###########################################
###################################################################################

Add_phylogeny <- function(prefix, physeq_file, Tree_file) {

  message("🚀 Ajout de la phylogénie : ", prefix)

  # 1. upload cleaned phyloseq
  physeq_clean <- readRDS(physeq_file)
  message("📊 N samples : ", nsamples(physeq_clean))
  message("📊 N taxa avant arbre : ", ntaxa(physeq_clean))

  # 2. upload tree
  message("🌳 Lecture de l'arbre depuis : ", Tree_file)
  tree_raw <- ape::read.tree(Tree_file)
  message("🌿 N tips dans l'arbre brut : ", length(tree_raw$tip.label))

  # 3. tree and phyloseq names HarmoniZation
  taxa_physeq <- taxa_names(physeq_clean)

  # --- Correct tree lables : Delete "_R_" prefix---
  taxa_tree_raw <- tree_raw$tip.label
  message("🧾 Exemple labels arbre AVANT nettoyage :")
  print(head(taxa_tree_raw, 10))

  # Delete "_R_" prefix
  taxa_tree_clean <- gsub("^_R_", "", taxa_tree_raw)

  # add cleaned labels to the tree
  tree_raw$tip.label <- taxa_tree_clean

  message("🧾 Exemple labels arbre APRÈS nettoyage :")
  print(head(tree_raw$tip.label, 10))

  # Debug : compare names sets
  taxa_in_physeq_not_in_tree <- setdiff(taxa_physeq, tree_raw$tip.label)
  taxa_in_tree_not_in_physeq <- setdiff(tree_raw$tip.label, taxa_physeq)

  message("❗ Taxa dans phyloseq mais PAS dans l'arbre (après nettoyage) : ",
          length(taxa_in_physeq_not_in_tree))
  message("   Exemple (jusqu'à 20) :")
  print(head(taxa_in_physeq_not_in_tree, 20))

  message("❗ Taxa dans l'arbre mais PAS dans phyloseq (après nettoyage) : ",
          length(taxa_in_tree_not_in_physeq))
  message("   Exemple (jusqu'à 20) :")
  print(head(taxa_in_tree_not_in_physeq, 20))

  # Intersection after cleaning
  taxa_communs <- intersect(taxa_physeq, tree_raw$tip.label)
  message("🔗 Taxa en commun entre phyloseq et arbre (après nettoyage) : ",
          length(taxa_communs))

  if (length(taxa_communs) == 0) {
    stop("❌ Aucun taxon en commun entre l'arbre et l'objet phyloseq. Vérifie les noms (OTU IDs) !")
  }

  # 4. Keep only taxa common to the tree and the phyloseq
  # If all phyloseq taxa are in the tree (expected), ntaxa don't change.
  tree_pruned   <- ape::keep.tip(tree_raw, taxa_communs)
  physeq_pruned <- prune_taxa(taxa_communs, physeq_clean)

  message("📉 N taxa après harmonisation : ", ntaxa(physeq_pruned))
  message("🌿 N tips dans l'arbre pruned : ", length(tree_pruned$tip.label))

  # 5. add the tree to phyloseq
  physeq_with_tree <- merge_phyloseq(
    physeq_pruned,
    phy_tree(tree_pruned)
  )

  # 6. Save
  output_file <- paste0("Phyloseq_with_tree_", prefix, ".rds")
  saveRDS(physeq_with_tree, output_file)
  message("💾 Objet sauvegardé sous : ", output_file)

  return(physeq_with_tree)
}




# === Apply ===

physeq_16s_with_tree <- Add_phylogeny(
  prefix      = "16S",
  physeq_file = "Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds",
  Tree_file   = "centroids.tre"
)
